text:
hana: Planning a micro-refresh of the Hello quickstart to sync examples with SDK v8 and the token rename. Will make tiny commits: env var rename, JS/Py snippet tweaks, updated minimal Dockerfile, and one-link fix.
omar: Sounds good. Please call out the rename prominently so users searching for REDWOOD_API_KEY see the change.
lina: Can you paste the new JS snippet so I can run it in snippet-runner?
hana: Sure:
```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ token: process.env.REDWOOD_TOKEN });
const out = await client.text.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hi!' });
console.log(out.output_text || out.output[0].content);
```
doc-bot: snippet-runner started for docs/quickstart at 2822230010.
omar: One quick ask: add a line "Where to find your token" pointing to Console -> API keys. Users keep opening support tickets.
hana: Will do, plus a screenshot placeholder.
doc-bot: snippet-runner finished: 0 errors, 1 warning (non-deterministic sample output).
lina: Ran locally, found README had old env var in a bash block. I'll open a tiny fix PR against your branch if that's ok.
hana: Great  please do. I'll consolidate and open the final PR. Assign @lina and @omar for reviews. Closing after merge.
